summary: Three teenage snowmobilers stranded overnight in a blizzard in the Routt National Forest north of Craig; sleds stuck in 2-3 ft of snow; survived by burning firewood and the fuel of one snowmobile; reached by search crews about 8 a.m. Monday after a ~15-hour search; two treated for minor injuries.
location: Routt National Forest north of Craig
notes: Date APPROXIMATE: article (page metadata dated ~2012-02-22) says stranded Sunday, rescued Monday ~8 a.m. -> 2012-02-20 (Monday-verified). Moffat County pinned via AP 'stranded north of Craig' + 9News/KUSA mirror. Responding agency unnamed in source ('search crews').
